name: Single-Scattering Atmosphere Rendering
definition: Renders the sky and atmospheric scattering by numerically integrating single scattering along a ray through a spherical atmosphere shell, accumulating Rayleigh and Mie contributions weighted by view and light transmittance.
summary: Single-Scattering Atmosphere Rendering models sky color by integrating Rayleigh and Mie scattering through an exponentially decaying planetary atmosphere, unlike homogeneous volume rendering.
